units.source_text: 从河流上游妓馆来的两个女人，摇晃着身子，从岩石上跳下来，要在旅馆的温泉浴场偷偷洗澡。

en.t: Two women from the brothel upstream came swaying down and jumped from the rocks, intending to slip into the inn's hot spring bath in secret.

units.source_text: 后边还跟来了几个汉子。

en.t: Several men followed behind them as well.

units.source_text: 阿泷扔下膝上的阿雪，站起身来说：

en.t: Otaki set Oyuki down from her lap, rose to her feet, and said:
